chunks: And he, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Charity given in secret extinguishes the wrath of the Lord, majestic is His majesty."

key_terms.الرَّبِّ: the Lord; Allah as the sustaining and governing Lord
key_terms.السِّرِّ: secrecy; giving privately without public display
key_terms.جَلَّ جَلَالُهُ: majestic is His majesty; a formula of exaltation for Allah
key_terms.صَدَقَةُ: charity; an act of giving for the sake of Allah

ai.seo_question: What is the virtue of giving charity in secret in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the virtue of giving charity discreetly and sincerely. It emphasizes that hidden charity has a special spiritual effect, serving as a means of averting divine wrath and drawing near to Allah.
